name: UelloSend SMS for WooCommerce
author: Universal Vision Technologies

sections.description:
Sends WooCommerce order and account related SMS notifications to customers and admin using UelloSend SMS Gateway. Designed specifically for Ghanaian phone numbers (+233).

New in version 1.1.0:
* Message Templates: Customize every SMS with dynamic placeholders.
* SMS Logs: View history of sent and failed messages in the admin dashboard.
* Dry Run Mode: Test the plugin without sending real SMS (saves credits).
* Customer Opt-out: Compliance feature allowing customers to opt-out of notifications.
* Multiple Admins: Send notifications to comma-separated list of numbers.

Notes

You will need to
1. Register at https://uellosend.com and generate API Keys at https://uellosend.com/user-api.php .
2. Register your SenderID at https://uellosend.com/register-brand.php and get it approved.
3. Top up your account with credit before you can send messages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/uellosend-sms-for-woocommerce directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings at Settings > UelloSend SMS.
    or
  4. Simply download the zip file and upload to WordPress via Add New Plugin user interface.
  5. Activate the plugin and configure it by clicking on Settings button.
  6. Fill in the API KEY, Sender ID and Admin Phone Number fields, save settings and that is all.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes! The plugin is free. SMS credits are purchased separately from UelloSend.

Can it send SMS to any number?

This plugin is optimized for Ghanaian numbers (+233).

Does it cost to send the SMS?

Yes! You must have credit in your UelloSend account.
